[element-self-uri]
=== `<self-uri>` Uri For This Same Article Online

URI for another version of a standards document. This element may be used when the document is available in multiple forms (for example, printed and eBook and online).

#### Usage/Remarks
The textual content of this element may be a URI (typically naming a website) when the text is used as a live link, or the element content may just be a few words and the linking attributes hold the real link.
